title: Foundation guardrails over a Terraform plan
scenario: Tessellate is moving its landing zone to GCP: folders, projects, a Shared VPC, org policies and a GitHub Actions Workload Identity Federation pool, all in Terraform. InfoSec will only approve the CI apply path if every plan is checked against the foundation guardrails before apply, the way gcloud beta terraform vet checks a plan. You get the plan JSON of the first foundation PR and a starter checker with three rules done.
task: Implement the remaining guardrails (GR002-GR005, GR007, GR008) in guardrails.py over terraform show -json output
Evaluate planned values, skip destroys and data sources, and treat values unknown until apply as warnings
Keep the CLI contract: text or --json output, exit 0 / 1 / 2
Explain in ANSWER.md how each rule maps to the AWS control you would have used
acceptance: The foundation plan produces exactly the expected error findings
GitHub OIDC providers without an owner or repository pin are rejected, including conditions joined with ||
Org policy shapes (boolean, deny_all, allowed_values) checked only at the organization
Unknown-at-plan values never crash the checker and never pass silently

practices.label: Week 1 - Mon: resource hierarchy and IAM
Week 1 - Thu: org policies and VPC Service Controls
Week 3 - policy validation on the plan
